_comment: Pinned versions. Bump these deliberately and commit the change, so every contributor builds the same thing. TBD entries are picked in their own threads and pinned to an exact commit.

port._comment: Doom source port we patch. UZDoom is the maintained GZDoom fork (5.0, 2026). Cloned into <repo>/port, patched from port-patches/.
port.name: UZDoom

server._comment: Open-source RotMG private server run locally only. Cloned into <repo>/server, patched from server-patches/.
server.name: TKR

client._comment: RotMG client build that matches the server's protocol version. TKR ships its own AS3 client (based on the RotMG 7.0 Flash client) in server/TK-Client at the same commit; `setup.py client` compiles it with the Harman AIR SDK into ../reference/rotmg/client. It talks only to 127.0.0.1:2000 (Parameters.LOCAL_HOST = true).

references._comment: RotMG's pet system, ported into server-patches/0004 (server code, AGPL-3.0). Read only.
references.name: NR-CORE

references._comment: NR's 27.7 client: scripts/pets.py takes RotMG's pet data (object XML) and pet sprite sheets from it at build time. Its pet screens were not ported (they need most of this client); ours are in server-patches/0005.
references.name: NR-client

references._comment: Mad Lab's full-size layout (scripts/dungeons.py copies it into TK at build time) and the Horrific Creation / Mad Gas Controller AI ported into server-patches/0007. Read only.
references.name: alloy-server
